_about: The store-frame set for the first public release, read by compose.py. Figures here come only from Planning/Store-Listing-Draft.md §5. A shot with no `capture` renders as a placeholder carrying its `route`. `keepFoot` fits the capture whole so a disclosure the app draws at the foot of the screen stays in the frame. Order is the order the listing shows; `all` is the universal opening the three audiences share.

ipad-13-landscape.note: iPad 13-inch, landscape; App Store Connect also takes 2064×2752 portrait and 2048×2732. Verify on Apple's current table before export.

mac.note: Mac, 16:10; App Store Connect takes 2880×1800, 2560×1600, 1440×900 or 1280×800. Verify before export.
